paper_title: Resonant detection of axion mediated forces with Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
suggested_experiment_name: NMR axion-mediated force (Arvanitaki-Geraci proposal), existing bounds
notes: Proposal/projection paper for resonant NMR detection of axion-mediated monopole-dipole (g_sN*g_pN) and dipole-dipole forces. Fig. 2 shows projected reach in |g_sN*g_pN| vs force range (0.01-10 cm, corresponding to fa 1e9-1e12 GeV).
